Raphoe.fact: In 1633, John Leslie was translated from the Scottish See of the Isles to become the bishop of Raphoe. Marrying at the age of 67, and absorbing the Bishopric of Clogher at the age of 90, Leslie dominated the area until his death, aged 100, in 1671.
